rationale: The entry sensor fails even when placed next to the base station after a factory reset, which matches the escalation policy condition (5) and the HW_FAULT_SUSPECTED label. The customer also mentioned dropping the sensor on tiles, which could have caused physical damage.

Could it be signal? The entry is three walls away from the base in normal use, but I tested it right next to the base.
